maya: Quick heads-up: we're rolling out artifact signing + provenance metadata for SDKs and docs samples. Enforcement plan below. :loudspeaker:
kenji: Short summary for devs?
maya: Signed artifacts preferred immediately; warnings for unsigned. Enforcement date: 2025-05-31. 60-day grace for pinned CI.
olivia-k: Private/offline installs?
maya: Customers must import our verification key or use the provided verifier script. We'll publish a one-line import and an installer bundle.
security-bot: Reminder: SBOMs will be generated per release and scanned for unexpected native deps. This reduces supply-chain risk.
kenji: CI impact?
maya: Add signing step to release GH Actions. For legacy CI set REDWOOD_ALLOW_UNSIGNED=1 temporarily (deprecation logs).
olivia-k: Docs changes?
maya: Each code sample will include a Provenance card with SBOM link and sig fingerprint. We'll also add a short runbook.
maya: I'll publish the RFC link in #docs and drop a customer-facing KB draft for CS. Ping me for reviews. Thanks!
